netlist:
* Spicey Electrons circuit at 20 C
.options rshunt=1e12 reltol=1e-3 method=gear
.temp 20
vam_SIG1 n1 SIG1_am 0
V_SIG1 SIG1_int 0 SIN(0 20 50)
R_SIG1_in SIG1_am SIG1_int 0.1
vam_T1 n1 T1_am 0
vam_T1_p1 0 T1_p1 0
vam_T1_p2 n2 T1_p2 0
vam_T1_p3 0 T1_p3 0
L_T1p T1_am T1_pl 1
R_T1_pw T1_pl T1_p1 0.1
L_T1s T1_p2 T1_sl 0.25
R_T1_sw T1_sl T1_p3 0.025
K_T1 L_T1p L_T1s 0.999
vam_D1 n2 D1_am 0
D_D1 D1_am n3 1N4007
vam_C1 n3 C1_am 0
C_C1 C1_am 0 0.00047
vam_R1 n3 R1_am 0
R_R1 R1_am 0 470
.model 1N4007 D(IS=7.02767n RS=0.0341512 N=1.80803 EG=1.05743 XTI=5 BV=1000 IBV=5e-08 CJO=1e-11 VJ=0.7 M=0.5 FC=0.5 TT=1e-07)
.control
set filetype=binary
tran 0.0001 0.1 0 0.0001
write __OUT__ v(n1) v(n2) v(n3) i(vam_sig1) i(vam_t1) i(vam_d1) i(vam_c1) i(vam_r1) i(vam_t1_p1) i(vam_t1_p2) i(vam_t1_p3)
quit
.endc
.end
